stakeholder.name: Priya Raman
stakeholder.role: Head of Compliance and Data Protection Officer

business_goals.statement: Keep every customer communication compliant with state unfair claims practices regulations

functional.statement: Require licensed adjuster approval before any letter is sent
functional.source_quote: No letter leaves this company without a licensed adjuster approving it.

functional.statement: Record an audit trail per letter (approver, AI draft, model and prompt version) and retain it for seven years
functional.source_quote: For every letter we need an audit trail: who approved it, the AI draft, and the model and prompt version that produced it.

functional.statement: Block coverage determinations and admissions of liability in drafts
functional.source_quote: It must never make or imply a coverage determination, and it must never admit liability.

functional.statement: Verify claim numbers, dates and dollar amounts in every draft match the claim system exactly
functional.source_quote: Claim numbers, dates and dollar amounts must match the claim system exactly - zero tolerance.

functional.statement: Test tone and helpfulness for consistency across customer demographics before go-live
functional.source_quote: Tone and helpfulness must not vary by the customer's name, age or postcode.

non_functional.statement: Claim data must stay in US regions
non_functional.source_quote: Claim data must stay in US regions.

non_functional.statement: Retain the per-letter audit trail for seven years
non_functional.source_quote: Keep that audit trail for seven years.

non_functional.statement: No customer PII in application logs (mask it)
non_functional.source_quote: And no customer PII in application logs - mask it.

non_functional.statement: Claim numbers, dates and amounts in drafts match the claim system exactly
non_functional.source_quote: Claim numbers, dates and dollar amounts must match the claim system exactly - zero tolerance.

non_functional.statement: Tone and helpfulness must not vary by customer name, age or postcode
non_functional.source_quote: Tone and helpfulness must not vary by the customer's name, age or postcode.
